Duration values are immutable tagged records with own u64 BigInt seconds and normalized u32 BigInt nanoseconds below 1000000000; private fields describe the lowering ABI, not source-level constructor permission. Checked operations return frozen Rust Option values; ordinary operation overflow and invalid float constructors abort as Rust panics, never synthetic successful Results. Source-derived fixtures establish the adapter subset; Rust differential execution stays gated on complete JavaScript checks.

items.source:
pub const HELP: &crate::translation_core::Str = "Commands:\n\
    /status — credential state, accounts and usage\n\
    /tokens — list issued tokens (ids, labels and limits, never values)\n\
    /issue [label] [ttl_hours] [max_requests] [key=value …] — issue a token;\n\
    \x20   options: label, ttl_hours, max_requests, max_tokens,\n\
    \x20   rate_limit_per_minute, account\n\
    /show <id> — every constraint, counter and state for one token\n\
    /rotate-token <id> [key=value …] — reissue a token, keeping its limits\n\
    /revoke <id> — revoke a token\n\
    /rotate — replace the admin credential\n\
    /auth <token> — sign in with an admin credential\n\
    /logout — forget the credential bound to this chat";

body.value:
Commands:
/status — credential state, accounts and usage
/tokens — list issued tokens (ids, labels and limits, never values)
/issue [label] [ttl_hours] [max_requests] [key=value …] — issue a token;
    options: label, ttl_hours, max_requests, max_tokens,
    rate_limit_per_minute, account
/show <id> — every constraint, counter and state for one token
/rotate-token <id> [key=value …] — reissue a token, keeping its limits
/revoke <id> — revoke a token
/rotate — replace the admin credential
/auth <token> — sign in with an admin credential
/logout — forget the credential bound to this chat
